interpretation.co_residency_explanation: unsupported: I-S was negative in both halves
interpretation.duplicate_observer_explanation: inconclusive/unsupported for correction: D-I positive but smaller than D within-condition variation, and controller topology differs from original independent Python processes
interpretation.topology_limit: Candidate and idle observer are threads in one Python process and share its GIL; original formal run used independent controller processes. This limits transfer of any measured observer effect. I-S also includes the extra idle controller lifecycle polling.

resource_boundary: Common before/after counters include boundary observation work. Python controller CPU/IO includes both sampler threads and orchestration; per-thread periodic CPU traces isolate collection sections but per-thread IO is not available. Matched-tree deltas exclude unmatched/new identities; all raw counters remain retained.

protocol.setup_calls: One candidate first-use and one idle B3 first-use, separately labeled and excluded from 18.

conditions.S: Candidate only; B3 root and descendants absent
conditions.I: B3 ready/minimized, only its periodic sampler gate cleared
conditions.D: Same B3 ready/minimized, periodic sampler enabled at 200ms

protocol.constants: One candidate PID, persistent CDP connection, ready Software route/presentation, own 200ms sampler and identical instrumented binary throughout.
protocol.resources: Common before/after candidate, idle, Python observer/controller and persistent Node driver counters; periodic per-thread observer CPU/wall traces. Controller process IO includes both sampler threads and orchestration, not exclusive per-thread IO.
protocol.stop_rule: Any prerequisite/identity/semantic/phase/lifecycle failure stops the declared run. No extra rounds or replacement samples.
protocol.interpretation: Compare I-S and D-I in both mirrored halves. Direction reversal or effect no larger than within-condition variation does not support interference. No sub-5000 result is an acceptance pass.
protocol.scope: Software inventory only; no cleanup/maintenance/uninstall. No product threads are paused.
